summary: {person} asks two supervisors how often the same floor should be washed.
realLife: Seattle crew chiefs gave auditors substantially different answers about how frequently crews should wet-clean restroom floors.
gates: Two districts delivering the same service under a common procedure.
weights: A resident crossing a district boundary is more likely to notice a difference.
inGame: needs: district procedures, crew instructions and available shift hours.

turns.what: They compare their route sheets in the meeting.
turns.writesBack: Flag the conflicting instructions for revision.

turns.what: The director checks whether the crews have time to follow it.
turns.writesBack: Tie the capacity review to the written standard.
